card.name: Where a body is hung or buried
card.fires_on: Small words right after a verb of hanging, burying or interring a person, such as from, on, the, them, or a. It marks the spot where a body or remains are about to be placed, in history, myth or religious text.

modes.label: Hanging
modes.description: Preposition or article after hanged or hung, before the tree or stake.

modes.label: Burial
modes.description: Word after buried, interred or remains to, before the grave, church or cemetery.
modes.example: Only a few persons followed his remains to<< the>> cemetery.

card.writes: It seems to prepare words naming a place of burial or disposal, though the promoted tokens are mixed and unclear.
card.plain: It lights up on the small word after someone is hanged or buried, just before the place is named.
